en.headline: Customs seizes 18 kg ketamine and 3 kg cannabis at airport, arrests two
en.dek: A local woman arriving from Zurich and a Malaysian man from Bangkok were stopped with the drugs hidden in check-in luggage; the haul is valued at about HK$7.9 million.
body: Hong Kong Customs detected two drug trafficking cases involving incoming passengers at Hong Kong International Airport on Thursday, seizing about 18 kilograms of suspected ketamine and about 3 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds with a total estimated market value of about HK$7.9 million.

In the first case, a 35-year-old local woman who arrived from Zurich, Switzerland, was found to have about 18 kilograms of suspected ketamine, valued at about HK$7.3 million, concealed in her check-in suitcase. She was arrested during customs clearance.

In the second case, a 27-year-old Malaysian man who arrived from Bangkok, Thailand, had about 3 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds, valued at about HK$0.6 million, concealed in his check-in suitcase. He was also arrested. Investigation of both cases is ongoing, Customs said.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲18公斤氯胺酮及3公斤大麻花 拘兩人
zh.dek: 一名由蘇黎世抵港的本地女子及一名由曼谷抵港的馬來西亞男子，在託運行李藏毒被截獲，估計總市值約790萬元。
body: 香港海關星期四在香港國際機場偵破兩宗入境旅客販毒案，檢獲約18公斤懷疑氯胺酮及約3公斤懷疑大麻花，估計總市值約790萬元，兩人被捕。
第一宗案中，一名35歲本地女子由瑞士蘇黎世抵港，關員在其託運行李箱內發現約18公斤懷疑氯胺酮，估計市值約730萬元，女子在清關時被拘捕。
第二宗案中，一名27歲馬來西亞男子由泰國曼谷抵港，託運行李箱內藏有約3公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約60萬元，同樣被拘捕。海關表示兩案仍在調查中。
